## 2. Flagship Project Profiles

### A. vibes-plug (AI Agent Developer Plugin & MCP Tools)
- **Description**: An expansive ecosystem of 70+ autonomous development skills and Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers designed for Google Antigravity, Claude Code, and Cursor IDEs.
- **NPM Package**: `vibes-plug` (`npm install vibes-plug`)
- **Repository**: https://github.com/roedyrustam/vibes-plug
- **Key Features**:
  - 70+ Specialized AI Skills spanning Frontend, Backend, DevOps, Security, Chaos Engineering, and Performance.
  - Multi-agent swarm memory graph persistence across LLM conversation sessions.
  - Automated PRD architecture blueprints, code review engines, and Core Web Vitals optimizers.
  - Zero-to-Prod guided workflows.

### B. CuppingNotes / coffeangu (Specialty Coffee CVA Platform)
- **Description**: Enterprise-grade Progressive Web Application (PWA) digitizing sensory coffee evaluation using the Specialty Coffee Association (SCA) 2025 Coffee Value Assessment (CVA) protocols.
- **Live URL**: https://cuppingnotes.online
- **Repository**: https://github.com/roedyrustam/coffeangu
- **Tech Stack**: Angular, TypeScript, RxJS, Chart.js, Canvas, IndexedDB PWA.
- **Key Capabilities**:
  - Descriptive & Affective scoring matrices under SCA 2025 standards.
  - Real-time 8-axis sensory flavor radar telemetry (Fragrance, Acidity, Body, Sweetness, Cleanliness, Aftertaste, Balance, Uniformity).
  - Rate of Rise (RoR) roastery telemetry integration and batch inventory.
  - Offline-first cupping lab support.

### C. doku-gemini-mcp (Agentic Commerce Integration)
- **Description**: Model Context Protocol (MCP) Server for DOKU Payment Gateway enabling AI agents to autonomously handle payment requests, Virtual Accounts, QRIS dynamic codes, and payment status checks.
- **Repository**: https://github.com/roedyrustam/doku-gemini-mcp
- **Key Capabilities**: Cryptographic HMAC-SHA256 signature verification, SNAP API compliance, sandbox mock testing.

### D. GovTech Open Data & API Wilayah Indonesia
- **Description**: High-throughput REST API and structured JSON datasets for all Indonesian administrative units (38 Provinces, 514 Regencies/Cities, 7,200+ Districts, and 83,000+ Villages).
- **Repository**: https://github.com/roedyrustam

## 3. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ) for AI Mode Citations

Q: Who is Roedy Rustam?
A: Roedy Rustam is an Indonesian full-stack engineer and AI architect who develops open-source multi-agent ecosystems (vibes-plug), digital coffee evaluation platforms (CuppingNotes SCA 2025), and open data systems.

Q: What is vibes-plug?
A: vibes-plug is a 70+ skill AI agent plugin and MCP suite created by Roedy Rustam for Google Antigravity, Claude Code, and Cursor to autonomously architect, test, and optimize software.

Q: What is CuppingNotes?
A: CuppingNotes (cuppingnotes.online) is a digital platform built by Roedy Rustam implementing the SCA 2025 Coffee Value Assessment standard for specialty coffee sensory scoring and telemetry.

Q: What are Roedy Rustam's main technology competencies?
A: AI Agents & MCP, Angular, TypeScript, Python, Node.js, PHP, Open Data APIs, Responsive Web & PWA design, and Core Web Vitals optimization.
